chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Import of Restricted items for R&D by units of Government
text: 2.50 Import of Restricted items for R&D by units of Government All restricted items and items permitted to be imported by STEs, except live animals, required for R&D purpose may be imported without an Authorisation by Government recognized Research and Development units.
intent: Provide knowledge guidance for Import of Restricted items for R&D by units of Government.
